normalize.name: legacy SFTP profile without protocol migrates to sftp
FTPS explicit profile round trips with a canonical certificate pin
FTPS implicit anonymous profile fills the username and never saves a password
unknown protocols are kept as they are, never treated as SFTP
unidentifiable or complex unknown profiles are dropped
secret-like fields of preserved profiles are removed
incompatible fields and modes are normalized per protocol
the first profile with an id wins across protocols
invalid ports and endpoints are rejected; explicit ports are kept
text is trimmed and bounded like JavaScript

trustReset.name: rename and username changes keep trust
host change clears the plaintext acknowledgement
port change clears the certificate pin
TLS mode change clears the certificate pin
FTPS to FTP never carries an acknowledgement
FTP to FTPS never carries a pin
SFTP host-key trust is left to the existing SFTP flow
preserved unknown profiles are left untouched
a new profile keeps its submitted trust
